entities.summary: Salsabila Khairunnisa is an Indonesian environmental activist. At the age of fifteen years old, she co-founded the Jaga Rimba youth movement, which aims to fight deforestation and exploitation in Indonesia. In 2020, she was nominated as one the BBC's 100 Women Award.
